scope: Read-only investigation of Pagination text advances and the approved Aptos Regular font; no font, global style or UI changes.
status: Verified browser/font math; original Figma font binary and shaping identity remain unverified.

font.approvedSource: User-supplied approved Microsoft Aptos Fonts package, Aptos.ttf

excludedFace.conclusion: The bundled face is Aptos Regular; the separate Display face is not the source of the browser's measured Week width.

figmaMetadata.method: Read-only figma_use_figma calls using exact known TEXT node IDs and getStyledTextSegments; no Figma nodes or fonts were modified.
figmaMetadata.interpretation: The Figma tool environment has no available Aptos face and reports these existing text nodes as having a missing font. The recorded frame geometry is readable, but the tool cannot identify or reproduce the original author's Aptos binary/version or font shaping. This finding concerns the tool environment; it does not establish the font availability in the author's own Figma session.
figmaMetadata.featureLimit: An empty openTypeFeatures map records no explicit feature overrides. It does not prove whether kerning was enabled or disabled by the original rendering environment.

measurements.method: Parsed the approved and bundled TrueType cmap/hmtx/GPOS tables with Python standard-library struct/hashlib; independently compared the result with Chromium Canvas measureText using the loaded bundled face.

conclusions.finding: The browser's Week width is explained exactly by the approved Aptos Regular 2.01 advances and its We kerning pair; it is not evidence of fallback or an accidental Display face.
Rounding the current kerned Week advance upward gives 62px, so a ceil-only explanation of Figma's 63px frame is incomplete.
Disabling kerning and rounding upward is numerically compatible with the 63px frame, but the available Figma metadata does not establish that this was the intended setting.
The original Figma font binary/version and shaping behavior are unverified. Missing-font tool metadata and preserved text frames cannot settle their identity.

Retain the approved font bytes and source typography settings. Do not add hardcoded label widths, substitute fonts, or change global kerning/letter spacing solely to force these unexplained intrinsic text-frame differences.

provenance.fontFiles: Registry-owned Aptos.ttf and the task-supplied approved Aptos.ttf were hashed independently; hashes and all relevant metrics matched.
provenance.fontParser: Read-only temporary Python probe using only struct, json, hashlib and pathlib; no additional font packages installed.
provenance.browserProbe: Independent Chromium Canvas probe on the production showcase, with document.fonts.ready awaited; auto/normal/none kerning measurements compared to table-derived values.
provenance.figmaProbe: Read-only Figma Plugin API exact-node properties, text segments and listAvailableFontsAsync, with figma-use guidance loaded.
provenance.portability: Repository paths are relative. The approved font package is identified logically rather than by a contributor's workstation directory.

limitations: No equality of Figma and Chromium raster pixels is claimed.
This investigation does not establish what font binary the original Figma author used.
No font, global CSS, component source, Figma document or deployment was modified for this investigation.

ownerClarification.originalFigmaFontPackage: The owner does not know which font package was used to author the Figma library.
ownerClarification.decision: Retain the supplied approved Aptos Regular 2.01. Do not guess at kerning or change global typography to force saved source widths.
